top: She was the last fluent speaker of her language. So, late in life, she taught herself to use a computer.
comment: Marie Wilcox spent 7 years typing a dictionary of Wukchumni, word by word, so her tribe's language wouldn't disappear with her.
topic_it: Marie Wilcox (Visalia, California), ultima parlante fluente del wukchumni, impara a usare il computer e scrive un dizionario della lingua (7 anni con l'aiuto della figlia); morta nel 2021

title: Why she learned to use a computer at her age #inspiring #tech #story
description:
Marie Wilcox, the last fluent speaker of Wukchumni, learned to use a computer and spent 7 years typing a dictionary so her language would survive.
